conflict_reported.statement: Lane worktree isolation and project hooks conflict as written. Cursor loads project hooks from <project-root>/.cursor/hooks.json, and the project root on this VM is /workspace, confirmed because core.hooksPath resolves to a directory whose base64 component decodes to /workspace. A lane working in its own worktree therefore places hooks outside the only directory Cursor reads them from, so they never fire for that lane.
conflict_reported.evidence: A benign command appended no line to the guard's audit log, and two commands matching the git|gh matcher executed instead of being refused. The installed guard denied the same commands when fed to it directly, establishing the control.
conflict_reported.why_the_lane_did_not_resolve_it: Writing hooks into /workspace would have altered every concurrently running sibling lane's turns mid-flight — the exact collision class worktree isolation exists to prevent. Refusing to fix one control by breaking another was the correct call.

reasoning: Hooks are a repository control bound to the project root. On any fresh agent run the platform clones the selected branch to /workspace, so a branch carrying .cursor/hooks.json puts those hooks at the project root automatically and they fire for that run's primary agent. Hooks are therefore effective going forward without anyone hand-installing them.
Worktrees are a concurrency control for parallel lanes inside one already-running VM. They exist because the contended resource is the working directory, which was proven by a live collision.
The two controls operate at different layers and address different failure modes. Treating them as competing was the error; they compose.

layers.scope: the primary agent of any run that checks out a branch containing it
layers.status: applied on the W2 branch; effective on future runs booting from a branch that carries it

layers.scope: every lane candidate, including worktree lanes hooks cannot reach
layers.acts: before a candidate is admitted to shared state
layers.status: in force now, 30 tests, wired into CI

residual_gap.statement: A lane running in an in-VM worktree can perform an act a hook would have refused. Only integration catches it, so for that population the control is detect-not-prevent.
residual_gap.why_it_is_acceptable_for_now: Lane writes are confined to isolated branches that reach shared state only through the root controller, and the guard rejects cross-namespace writes, contested paths, non-descendant heads and protected-ref drift before admission. The gap allows a wasted lane, not a corrupted estate.
residual_gap.what_would_close_it: Installing hooks at /workspace/.cursor before dispatching lanes, so every lane inherits prevention as well as detection.
residual_gap.why_that_is_deferred: Two sibling lanes are running now. Installing hooks into the shared project root mid-flight would change their turns underneath them.
residual_gap.trigger_to_close: Install at the shared project root at the next quiescent point, when no lane is executing, and verify firing with the re-runnable probe the lane shipped rather than by assumption.

second_finding_changes_a_founder_action.finding: This environment is database-managed, not repository-file managed. The lane established it positively rather than by inference: the environment-build override was accepted, and the tool contract states an override is rejected for repo-file managed environments.
second_finding_changes_a_founder_action.consequence: The applied .cursor/environment.json is correct, schema-valid against the live Draft 2019-09 schema, and inert. Its proven-working install script has no effect until the environment record points at it.
second_finding_changes_a_founder_action.supersedes: The earlier founder guidance treated authenticating MCP integrations as the whole of the environment work. It is not. Making environment.json govern is a separate action and is a precondition for warm starts.
second_finding_changes_a_founder_action.corrected_founder_action: At the environment dashboard, either point the environment at the repository file so git becomes the configuration source — recommended, because it keeps configuration versioned and reviewable — or paste the configuration into the saved record. The first option is strictly better for portability and matches the standing rule that no logic or state should be trapped in a provider.

third_finding_corrects_a_shipped_procedu.finding: The documented revert procedure in the staged APPLY.md does not work, reproduced against the applied tree.
third_finding_corrects_a_shipped_procedu.why_it_fails: The apply is what creates .gitignore, so it does not exist at the revert SHA; git checkout with a pathspec is atomic and exits 1 having reverted nothing. Even with a valid pathspec it would be incomplete, because restoring only paths present in the base tree leaves the twelve newly added files behind.
third_finding_corrects_a_shipped_procedu.verification: git diff --cached and git diff against the base tree both print nothing, and .cursor/environment.json hashes to af09d9f4d242d95e7f8701a817218178346b2ead32cbe085059d28e8fc85b2d6
third_finding_corrects_a_shipped_procedu.significance: A revert procedure that was written down but never executed is the same defect class as a lesson documented without changing the mechanism. Executing it before publishing it is the standard.

closure_defect_finally_fixed.history: An independent acceptor refused CUR-ORCH-QUAL-01 partly because its read-back record sat outside its own manifest, unbound by any hash. A later lane reproduced the same exclusion, having reasoned its way to it independently.
closure_defect_finally_fixed.now: This lane included READ-BACK.json inside the hashed entries and bound it again in a named field, leaving only MANIFEST.json excluded on the sound ground that a file cannot contain its own digest, and declaring that exclusion with the command to verify it.
closure_defect_finally_fixed.root_controller_confirmation: Verified by recomputation: 28 entries, bundle digest reproduces, zero uncovered files, zero paths outside scope.
closure_defect_finally_fixed.lesson: The correction only propagated once it travelled with the dispatch contract. Shipping a control after the workers have launched catches defects; it does not prevent them.

carried_hypothesis.statement: Whether .cursor/start.sh runs on a real agent run is untested. Install provably ran during the draft build; start did not, and the absence is meaningful because install's own echoes appear in the same log.
carried_hypothesis.how_it_gets_settled: Observe a fresh agent run booting from a branch carrying the configuration, once the environment record points at the repository file.
